documented_probe: C-b0268a38 (compute grouped/aggregated summaries over tabular and CSV inputs): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — a two-file join, an inclusive date-period filter, per-product revenue aggregation with deterministic ranking, and a grand total, all of which must land in the designated JSON output; wrong period filtering, a missed join, or mis-summed revenue mis-ranks the ground-truth list.
notes: Single-stage generalizable program: CSV join + inclusive period filter + grouped revenue aggregation + deterministic ranking (revenue desc, id asc tie-break) + total. Hidden cases cover header-only/invalid orders, boundary dates, unknown product ids, revenue ties, malformed rows, whitespace padding, negative quantities. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth, debugging_ambiguity, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
